svg.text: Interface connector (one per signal group; arrow = active to passive)

The enclosing frame is the generated module; the blocks inside are groups of its processes, except the synchronizer block that stands for four instances of the synchronizer module. Both clocks and resets reach every block of their domain.
Generated register module with an APB4 Completer, a request and acknowledge bridge between the bus clock and the register clock, and the register
bank. The APB interface is on the left and top, the field ports are on the right and bottom.
APBI, APBO, CFG, FLDI, HWL, FLDO,
Detects the SETUP phase, evaluates the protection, alignment and strobe error conditions, and captures the address and the write data.
Holds the transfer request and acknowledge state on the bus clock and drives the ready, error, and read data outputs.
Four two-flop synchronizers, one per single-bit crossing between the bus clock and the register clock.
Turns the synchronized requests into one-cycle enables on the register clock and returns the acknowledge.
Selects the register at the captured address and keeps the read data on the register clock.
Holds the field flip-flops and evaluates the next value of each field from the write, the hardware load, and the type.
